verdict.rationale: Ramp documents multi-entity support in a single consolidated account, with per-entity spend policies and controls, plus one-step syncing of transactions and reimbursements to multiple entities in the accounting system. Multi-currency evidence covers only reimbursements, paid in about 40 local currencies. Eligibility requires US registration with most operations and spend in the US, which limits multi-country entity setups. Missing for 10: explicit consolidated cross-entity reporting, multi-currency cards/accounts/books beyond reimbursements, details on per-entity ledgers and FX handling, and independent corroboration.
